usage: Persist this file inside your repositories as .codescene/custom-quality-gates.json

rule_sets.quality_gates_doc: The Bare Minimum profile for all code, as in the project UI. Options: bare_minimum, clean_code_collective, pay_down_tech_debt.
rule_sets.matching_content_path_doc: Glob relative to the repo root. Without a matching rule, no gate runs.
